docs.answer: The inner zone has 66.9% of all docks: 2,460 out of 3,677.
docs.sql: SELECT SUM(capacity) FILTER(WHERE zone = 'inner') AS inner_docks, SUM(capacity) AS all_docks, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(capacity) FILTER(WHERE zone = 'inner') / NULLIF(SUM(capacity), 0), 2) AS inner_percentage FROM marts.dim_station LIMIT 200
